items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: Clarence William published all of you.

ctx.x: It's a mistake here, I think.

No. No. No. No. Well, Clarence William published all of you. Nobody's blues but mine? No. That's one. Mm-hmm. See, we did... We had... She didn't... She had just started. Her first two numbers... All of them we didn't do but one side. I mean one side. I don't know who... I think that other girl took the other section. She did do four numbers in a session. Oh, let me...
Four numbers. Uh... Here is a session. Honey, you... Honey, don't go away.
